purpose: Compile the strongest Task14 and bracket scalar effect programs into a baseline-conditioned counterfactual answer-margin actuator that does not execute either native downstream suffix after receiving the native unedited answer margin.
prior_art_search: The v3 dispatcher stores 14,992 scalars and predicts intervention effects without a suffix, but its causal-execution API still installs 1,152-dimensional terms and invokes the native suffix.
The Task14 one- and two-reader absolute-head repairs are null, so no local base-state compression is available and rank escalation is closed.
No registered artifact exposes one common baseline-margin-plus-effect actuator API for both behaviors or prices the removal of all intervention vectors and downstream execution.

construction.input: one native unedited answer margin plus a discrete edit specification
construction.task14_rule: look up one of ten frozen direction-by-cardinality effects and add it to the native margin
construction.bracket_rule: look up one of six frozen ordered-pair effects, or zero for a self-pair, and add it to the native margin

predictions.pred_a_immutable_sources_and_exact_compi: All four source hashes match; exactly ten Task14 and six bracket scalar effects are copied bit-exactly from v3.
predictions.pred_b_task14_effect_recurrence: The frozen Task14 scalar effects retain cosine at least 0.95, relative L2 at most 0.35, and sign agreement at least 0.95 against all 512 prospective installed-program effects.
predictions.pred_c_bracket_effect_recurrence: The frozen bracket scalars retain cosine at least 0.99, relative L2 at most 0.15, and sign agreement 1.0 against all 72 untouched fresh-construction effects; every ordered pair retains sign agreement 1.0.
predictions.pred_d_exact_margin_actuation_identity: For every recorded target, predicted edited margin minus actual edited margin equals predicted effect minus actual effect to absolute error at most 1e-12, for arbitrary finite baseline margins.
predictions.pred_e_suffix_and_price_reduction: After the native baseline margin is supplied, the actuator uses no model call, activation, site, base head, native suffix, or stored vector; it stores exactly 16 FP32 scalars (64 bytes), a reduction of at least 99.89% from v3.

terminal.screen: All five predictions pass. Release only as a baseline-conditioned counterfactual answer-margin actuator.
terminal.null: Any failed source, recurrence, identity, or price gate rejects the compiled actuator without tuning.

closed_claims: mechanistic equivalence between direct margin actuation and internal-site intervention
